neighbours.label: the opening of a sentence-initial subordinate clause or fragment (Because, ... / Although, ... / So that they ... / That we ...)
fire: The meeting dragged on for hours. Because, frankly, nobody had read the agenda.
She never complained about the noise. Although, to be fair, she rarely slept at home.
We packed extra blankets. So that we would not freeze, we also brought a stove.
He finally admitted the truth. That he had never actually seen the letter.
The garden looked wild all summer. Because, as it turned out, the gardener had quit.
The plan seemed perfect on paper. Although, he later wrote, the budget was a fantasy.
They locked the gate every night. So that the goats stayed in, they added a chain.
It still surprises me today. That a single phone call could change so much.
